title: AK C-17 deliver UH-60's to Hurricane Florence Relief Efforts
description: The McEntire Joint National Guard Base received a few out-of-town visitors on Monday night, from "The Last Frontier" State. Two UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters along with a 22-person crew were transported to the base by a C-17 plane, from Anchorage, AK. Along with Alaska, guardsmen from New York and Pennsylvania brought aircraft down to the Palmetto State to help with rescue efforts.
